name: Knighted Pikeman

skills.name: Preempt
skills.description: (Reaction) Before active attack from front/side, Strike Back up to 1/round.

skills.name: Parry
skills.description: (Passive) Before physical melee attack, faces attacker and adds P.ATK to P.DEF.

skills.name: Crescendo Combo
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Single-target, dispels 2 buffs, then Pursuit dealing DMG. Range 1-1.

skills.name: Knightly Spirit
skills.description: (Passive) Increases ATK when attacking from front; increases DEF when attacked from front.

summary: Epic frontline pikeman with Preempt counter and Crescendo Combo.
